description: Small reports under aps-tutorial/reports/; explicit user scope.
author: Anna Developer

tools.name: save_report
tools.description: Save a new Markdown report to personal APS.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Report text, at most 12 KiB UTF-8.

tools.name: list_reports
tools.description: Read one page of tutorial reports in user scope.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque next_cursor from the preceding page.

tools.name: get_report_url
tools.description: Mint a fresh short-lived URL for a tutorial report.

tools.name: delete_report
tools.description: Delete one previewed tutorial report after exact path confirmation.

tools.name: temporary_report
tools.description: Upload a temporary copy using host/uploadFile; no APS file is created.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Report text, at most 12 KiB UTF-8.
